theorem_contract.heat_face: beta=1 gives exp(-tA), all-order smoothing, every S_p, and norm exp(-t)
theorem_contract.long_time: t^beta*S_beta(t) converges in operator norm to A^{-1}/Gamma(1-beta)
theorem_contract.negative_theta_context: theta<0 also gives a bounded operator because A>=I, but it is outside the declared theta>=0 smoothing domain
theorem_contract.nonsemigroup: for beta<1 the strongly continuous solution family is not a semigroup
theorem_contract.positivity_contraction: S_beta(t) is positivity preserving, self-adjoint, positive, and contractive
theorem_contract.sharp_schatten: for beta<1 and t>0, S_beta(t) belongs to S_p exactly when p>1/2
theorem_contract.sharp_smoothing: for beta<1, t>0, and theta>=0, A^theta*S_beta(t) is bounded iff theta<=1
theorem_contract.subordination: for beta<1 S_beta is the inverse-stable subordination of the Dirichlet heat semigroup
